If it's in `message.message` then `json-editor` will try to render a control for it - so we'll always have to hide it via `display:none`.  We also don't have much of a schema for `message.message`.  We can add `counter?: number` to `message.details` though.

issues.title: Create new reference messages server-side
issues.body:
Currently, before we send a new message of any type other than chat, we do this in `checkReference`:
- get all docs
- filter for documents from this force, with a `.message.counter` field
- find the highest value of counter
- find all messages for this id

Retrieving all documents from the database seems an expensive process.

Is it possible to perform the above server-side?  

Something like:  `http://serge/wargame-23423/counter/force-red`

The processing would be almost the same, but it would happen in node.

comments.body: Hello Ian, yes it is possible
I am working on it now.
